title: That’s Mint Salt-Nic E-Liquid – Wintergreen 30ml
description:
Description
Embrace the icy allure of Wintergreen by That’s Mint, a tantalizing fusion of wintergreen and ice that delivers a refreshingly cool vaping experience!
Prepare to be swept away by the invigorating chill of That’s Mint; a carefully curated collection of premium salt nicotine e-liquids that will elevate your vaping experience to new heights! Specializing in nuanced mint and ice e-liquids, each flavour within the range is a testament to precision and excellence.
Whether you’re a seasoned vaper or new to the scene, That’s Mint promises an unforgettable experience that’s as refreshing as it is exhilarating. Explore the world of That’s Mint today and discover a new level of minty goodness that will leave you craving more!
That’s Mint Salt-Nic E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. That’s Mint Salt-Nic E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
